name: To Grant A Wish
source:
In 'To Grant A Wish' you play as a Minor Deity, whose presence has been fading due to a lack of worship. One day, you receive an offering on your shrine that grants you more power than you have had in a century, and you set out, determined to grant their wish. 

Unfortunately, this isn't quite so simple as it seems... 

[from [url=https://wizard-raz-studios.itch.io/to-grant-a-wish-demo-v2]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在“实现愿望”中，你扮演一个小神，由于缺乏崇拜，他的存在已经逐渐消失。有一天，你在神龛上收到一份祭品，它赋予你一个世纪以来从未有过的力量，你出发了，决心实现他们的愿望。

不幸的是，这并不像看起来那么简单…… 

[来自[url=https://wizard-raz-studios.itch.io/to-grant-a-wish-demo-v2]itch.io[/url]]
